svg.text: Modules plug into female headers on one perfboard. Labels with the same name are connected; × = not connected. Parts: hardware/mouser-bom.csv.
+3V3 comes from the ESP32 board's own regulator
(its 3V3 pin); it feeds U5 and the drivers' logic.
C4 / C5 right at each driver's VM and GND pins.
Motor current: turn the module's trimmer to Vref ≈ 0.5 V (≈ 0.35 A).
Motor coils to screw terminals J7 (MA_*) and J8 (MB_*): 1A/1B = coil 1, 2A/2B = coil 2.
C3 right across U5 pins 9 and 10.
